name_nl: Terminalsticker druk op de gele knop voor een parkeerkaart

template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

cut_contour.note: Proposal: new design without a die line; radius taken from the scan stickers of the sheet (4.65 mm). To be confirmed by the printer.

reference_note: New design: no print source and no reference. Look and sizes follow the terminal sticker sheet.
notes: 'Druk op de gele knop voor een parkeerkaart': two centred lines of navy text ('gele knop' and 'parkeerkaart' bold), then the yellow push button, an arrow and the parking ticket. The yellow of the button is a functional colour (observed token py-obs-geel-knop), to be matched to the real terminal button. New design after the sheet, no print source and no reference. Look and sizes follow the sheet: white sticker, navy Ubuntu text, navy line icons, hairline contour as ThruCut 0.2 mm inside the trim, 3 mm bleed. Corner radius 4.65 mm is taken from the scan stickers and is a proposal.
